title: GEFEG BatteryPass-Ready longlist attributes
authority: GEFEG (publication and validation channel for the Battery Pass Consortium)
usedFor: The few battery attributes reported to have no SAMM equivalent — a DPP-information group plus lossless-carrier keys.
finding: `namespaceIri` is null deliberately. The survey serves these terms under `https://ref.openepcis.io/vocab/batterypass-ready/1.3#` — an IRI minted by the surveying site, not by GEFEG. Recording it as GEFEG's namespace would assert GEFEG authority through a third party's coined identifier, which is the defect that put six wrong IDTA identifiers into a published crate in 2026-07. The attributes may well be real and worth having; the IRI is not GEFEG's to lend and not ours to borrow.
nextStep: Find out whether GEFEG publishes IRIs for these attributes at all. If it does not, they can only ever be modelled as our own terms with a citation to GEFEG — never under a namespace that implies GEFEG minted them.
